items.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
items.summary: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

items.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
items.summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

items.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
items.summary: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

items.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
items.summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

items.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
items.summary: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.

items.title: Was crypto self-custody ever designed for beginners?
items.summary: Recent hardware wallet security incidents have renewed debate over whether self-custody is suitable for beginners, as multisig and seedless designs carry their own risks.

items.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
items.summary: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
items.summary: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

items.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
items.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

items.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
items.summary: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

items.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
items.summary: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

items.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
items.summary: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.

items.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
items.summary: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
items.summary: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

items.title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
items.summary: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.

items.title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
items.summary: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.

items.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
items.summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

items.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
items.summary: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.
